The INGCO HES02855 Electrician’s Scissors is a high-quality, compact cutting tool designed for precision work in electrical, telecom, and networking applications. With a 145mm (5.5-inch) size, it is perfect for cutting wires, cable insulation, zip ties, and small components with ease.

Crafted from durable stainless steel, this scissor offers long-lasting sharpness and excellent cutting performance. The 3.0mm thick blades ensure strength and stability, making it reliable for daily professional use. Its ergonomic handle provides a comfortable and secure grip, reducing hand fatigue during extended tasks.

Lightweight and easy to carry, the INGCO HES02855 is an essential tool for electricians, technicians, and DIY users across Bangladesh.

  • High-quality stainless steel blades
  • 3.0mm thick blade for durability
  • Ergonomic anti-slip handle design
  • Smooth and efficient cutting performance
  • Lightweight and portable
  • Ideal for electrical and cable work
